# Banana Intelligence

> Banana Intelligence is Nate Peace's studio for personal media and tools. Motto: "Excellence. For everyone."

## Products

- [DayStart](https://daystartai.app): a personalized morning briefing podcast for iPhone. Your top story, calendar, and weather in about five minutes. Free to try.
- [Plain Ballot](https://plainballot.com): a free, open source ballot guide. Every position is quoted exactly with its source; party labels stay hidden until asked; it never says how to vote. Agents can use its MCP server.

## About

- [Nate Peace](https://natepeace.com): founder. Writes The Peace Process.
